core.description: This option is only retained for existing legacy connections. Home Assistant removes the legacy hub access API in 2027.10; connections still using it will then stop working. Follow the Core Modbus migration guide in the integration documentation before upgrading. The migration notification includes a link to the guide. Do not remove a YAML hub still used by other integrations.

data_description.message_wait_milliseconds: Minimum quiet interval between requests. Leave at 0 unless your inverter or adapter needs a delay; try 150 for affected Sofar connections. Increasing this slows polling and writes.

duplicate_inverter.description: Another inverter configuration already uses this Modbus connection and address. If both configurations are enabled, they will poll the same inverter and may cause communication problems. Submit to save anyway.
duplicate_inverter.title: Duplicate inverter configuration

data_description.modbus_request_summary_interval: Log summaries of Modbus communication reliability and response times, including request counts, retries and failures. Separate read and write reports appear in the Home Assistant log. Available for Home Assistant-managed Modbus connections. Set the interval in minutes; 0 disables reports.
data_description.modbus_request_summary_retries_only: When checked, report only intervals containing retries, separately for reads and writes. Unchecked by default: report all intervals containing requests. Intervals without requests are always omitted.
